All functions will return Go error values for invalid input or verification failures rather than panicking, matching the existing API style.
Example tests will be implemented as Go example functions in the package test files, demonstrating round-trip usage and satisfying the acceptance criteria.

No new third-party dependencies are needed; standard library and existing Fabric proto packages are sufficient.
Effort covers implementation, example tests, build verification, and minimal documentation (godoc); it excludes separate formal QA, deployment, or large-scale refactoring of unrelated code.
